code.script: data/v2/report_tti_secondary_metrics.py (written by the executor; mechanical, per this config)
code.imports_allowed: eval_protocol (repeated_group_kfold, bootstrap_ci); train_tti_v5_physics imported with sys.argv = [argv0, '--onset-bc', '--replicate-table'] exactly as train_blend_round1.data_tti() does (its __main__ block does not run); train_blend_round1 (Avg, et, ridge, log1p_wrap; it has a main guard); sklearn; scipy.stats.spearmanr
code.imports_forbidden: Do NOT import data/v2/train_tti_round1.py or data/v2/train_tti_round2.py: their module-level code fits every candidate and overwrites experiments/results/*.json. Copy the lines cited under data.extra_columns and models verbatim instead.

data.build: df = v5.df.copy() after importing train_tti_v5_physics as above
data.row_rule: All 681 rows train every model in every fold and enter scoring. No row or material is excluded anywhere (no Latex_Pillow_Foam or other exclusion, no 15 kW/m2 exclusion). The 6 operator-flagged rows (plan B4 / D4) stay in; the 675-row set is never used here.
data.extra_columns: round-1 columns q_kWm2 and q_over_dT exactly as train_tti_round1.py lines 32-33, and inv_z exactly as lines 39-40; round-2 columns exactly as train_tti_round2.py line 29 (SIGMA) and lines 35-55 (emissivity left join on material from data/v2/emissivity_fsri.csv: eps_h, eps_s, log_eps_h, log_q_excess_eps, has_emissivity). Extra columns never change a model's X: each model uses its explicit feature list.

protocol.cv: one call per model: eval_protocol.repeated_group_kfold(model, X, y, groups, n_splits=5, repeats=10, log_target=<model flag>), i.e. GroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=r) for r = 0..9, groups = material. Every metric below comes from that call's OOF array (10 x 681). No other fitting.
protocol.paired_folds: all models share rows and groups, so repeat r has identical folds for every model
protocol.seeds: CV repeats random_state 0..9; bootstrap seed 0, n_boot 2000; model seeds as recorded (ExtraTrees, RF and HGB random_state 0; GLM and Ridge deterministic)
protocol.pooled_seconds: per repeat r2_score(y, oof[r]) over all 681 rows; rkf_mean = mean of the 10; record CI = bootstrap_ci(y, oof[0], groups). This is the existing headline, computed only for the step-1 check and printed for context. It is not a secondary metric.

models (fixed order; nothing added, noth.role: shelf: blend round 1 TTI b1 (not adopted, 7/10)

e1-e4 (TTI round 2, emissivity): DROPPED by the orchestrator before commit (Oct 6). banned_moves grants the emissivity-join exemption 'for TTI round 2 only' (Arnav, Oct 5); a report-only refit is a new use, and a plan cannot widen a human-granted exemption. Strict reading applied.

masks.note: The 20 rows at 15, 35 and 100 kW/m2 get no separate metric; they enter only ALL and the legacy reconciliation.

metrics (all report-only).S25, S50, S75: seconds-scale R2 within one flux: sklearn r2_score(y[m], oof[r][m]) on raw predictions, no clipping
metrics (all report-only).S50_75: seconds-scale R2 on F50_75 pooled, same formula
metrics (all report-only).LOG_ALL: overall log-space R2: r2_score(np.log(y), np.log(np.clip(oof[r], 1e-6, None))) on all 681 rows (natural log of seconds, not log1p)
metrics (all report-only).LOG25, LOG50, LOG75: within-flux log-space R2, same formula on F25 / F50 / F75
metrics (all report-only).SPR25, SPR50, SPR75: within-flux row-level Spearman: scipy.stats.spearmanr(y[m], oof[r][m]).statistic (default average ranks for ties)
metrics (all report-only).SPM25, SPM50, SPM75: within-flux material-median Spearman: within mask m, per material take median(y) and median(oof[r]); spearmanr of the two across materials
metrics (all report-only).clip_floor: 1e-6 s, fixed (as skeptic_tti/alt.py and an1.py; the finder's blend10.py used 1e-3, identical for strictly positive predictions). Report n_clipped = number of (repeat, row) pairs with oof <= 1e-6, per model.
metrics (all report-only).not_computed: No other mask, metric, transform, exclusion or per-material breakdown is computed under this config (no log1p-space R2, no without-Latex or without-top-k checks, no 675-row variant, no family-GKF).

aggregation: For every model x metric: the 10 per-repeat values (r = 0..9), their mean and std (numpy default ddof=0, as eval_protocol / rk.std()), and the repeat-0 value. The headline cell is the 10-repeat mean +- std. Printed to 3 decimals, stored to 4. NaN rule: use np.mean / np.std (not the nan-aware versions), so a NaN in any repeat (e.g. spearmanr on constant predictions) makes that cell NaN; print it as 'nan', store null, and list it for the critic. No value is imputed, dropped or recomputed.
confidence_intervals: Repeat 0 only, eval_protocol.bootstrap_ci(y_s, p_s, g_s, n_boot=2000, seed=0) on the subset rows (materials resampled among those present in the subset). Computed for S25, S50, S75, S50_75 (y_s = y[m], p_s = oof[0][m]) and LOG_ALL (y_s = np.log(y), p_s = np.log(np.clip(oof[0], 1e-6, None))). No CI for LOG25/50/75 or any Spearman. A CI here is descriptive and is never compared with a bar.
paired_report: For each model other than exp046 and each of the 16 secondary metrics (S25, S50, S75, S50_75, LOG_ALL, LOG25, LOG50, LOG75, SPR25, SPR50, SPR75, SPM25, SPM50, SPM75; not the pooled-seconds headline and not the legacy masks): wins = number of repeats r with metric(model, r) > metric(exp046, r) (strict >; ties are not wins; a NaN on either side is not a win). Report-only, never a selection rule. Folds are paired (protocol.paired_folds).

legacy_reconciliation (labelled 'legacy.NOT25: heat_flux_kWm2 != 25.0 (458 rows: 15, 35, 50, 75, 100): seconds R2, repeat-0 value (equals the old 'other fluxes' log value) and 10-repeat mean +- std, for every model
legacy_reconciliation (labelled 'legacy.NOT25_NO15: heat_flux_kWm2 not in {15.0, 25.0} (455 rows): seconds R2, 10-repeat mean +- std, for every model. Printed only to show what drove the old 'other fluxes' figure; it is not a proposal to drop the 15 kW/m2 rows.
legacy_reconciliation (labelled 'legacy.label_checks: share of the NOT25 target sum of squares (around the NOT25 mean) held by the 3 Masonite_Board rows at 15 kW/m2 (expect 0.745); share of the all-row target sum of squares held by F25 rows (expect 0.852)

reference_ceilings (label-only, already: cells = material x heat_flux_kWm2 x spark_ignitor, as train_tti_v5_physics.ceiling(): in-sample cell-mean R2, and leave-one-replicate-out (LORO) cell-mean R2 on rows in cells with >= 2 replicates. Only these, with expected values: ALL in-sample 0.843 / LORO 0.690; F25 in-sample 0.776 / LORO 0.558; F50 LORO 0.958; F75 LORO 0.955. The own-50/75 oracle is NOT recomputed (aggregation-dependent; cite tti-3's range in prose only).
step1_reproduction: Before any secondary metric is printed: every model with a record must reproduce its pooled-seconds rkf_mean within 0.002 and its repeat-0 CI bounds within 0.002 (exp047's 3-decimal CI within 0.002 of the 3-decimal value); et_alone must reproduce rkf_mean 0.255 within 0.002; c5_ridge has no anchor. Any failure: STOP the whole run, write blockers/BLOCKER-<YYYYMMDD-HHMM>-tti-secondary-repro.md, publish no table.

step2_definition_check.purpose: Confirms the script implements the same definitions that produced the findings. A mismatch is an implementation fault: STOP and write the blocker. Never change a definition to make a number match.
step2_definition_check.tolerance: 0.002 for values given to 3 decimals; equal after rounding for values given to 2 decimals
step2_definition_check.et_alone: LOG_ALL 0.633, LOG25 0.292, S75 0.613, S50_75 0.580; wins 10/10 on each of these four
step2_definition_check.c5_ridge: wins vs exp046 between 8 and 10 on each of S50, S75, S50_75, LOG_ALL, LOG25
step2_definition_check.labels: label_checks and reference_ceilings equal their expected values within 0.002

selection_rule: none. No model is selected, ranked or adopted. Tables are printed in the fixed model order above, never sorted by a metric.

outputs.log: experiments/runs/tti_secondary_metrics.log (full stdout). Every table header line carries: 'REPORT-ONLY, defined post hoc (experiments/configs/tti_secondary_metrics.json); never promotes; not comparable to the 0.58 bar'.
outputs.json: experiments/runs/tti_secondary_metrics.json: {config, generated_at, step1: {model: {rkf_mean, ci, record, ok}}, step2: {check: {expected, got, ok}}, models: {id: {metric: {per_repeat[10], mean, std, rep0, ci_rep0 or null, wins_vs_exp046 or null}}, n_clipped}, legacy_reconciliation, label_checks, reference_ceilings}
outputs.printed_tables: (1) step-1 reproduction; (2) seconds per flux: S25, S50, S75, S50_75 mean +- std with rep-0 CI; (3) log: LOG_ALL [CI], LOG25, LOG50, LOG75; (4) Spearman: SPR and SPM per flux (10-repeat means; rep-0 in the JSON); (5) paired wins vs exp046 per metric; (6) legacy reconciliation and label checks; (7) reference ceilings
outputs.not_written: No experiments/results/*.json, no exp id, no scripts/update_trackers.py ingest, no leaderboard.csv / xlsx / numbers_of_record.json / STATUS.md / model card / report edit by the executor. OOF arrays are not committed (scratch only).

critic: A fresh-context critic writes experiments/critic/tti_secondary_metrics_critic.md before any number from this run is quoted anywhere (STATUS, model card, summary, blocker). It checks: the script against this config line by line; steps 1-2; that nothing is ranked, selected or set against 0.58; whether any metric is degenerate for a model (e.g. t2's capped back-transform in seconds, n_clipped); and the wording of any proposed doc text against reporting_rules.

reporting_rules.always_attach: Any quoted number from this run carries 'report-only, defined post hoc' and the pointer experiments/configs/tti_secondary_metrics.json.
reporting_rules.headline_template (after critic): Report-only secondary TTI metrics (defined after per-flux results were seen; experiments/configs/tti_secondary_metrics.json): within a single heat flux exp046 separates materials poorly (seconds R2 {S25} / {S50} / {S75} at 25 / 50 / 75 kW/m2, {S50_75} pooled over 50+75; log R2 {LOG25} / {LOG50} / {LOG75}). On overall log R2, {models with >= 8/10 wins on LOG_ALL, in model order, with their LOG_ALL means} score above exp046 ({exp046 LOG_ALL}). The seconds-scale TTI number of record is unchanged: exp046 0.313 [0.071, 0.496]. None of these numbers is compared with the 0.58 bar.
reporting_rules.headline_template_empty_case: If no model is above exp046 on LOG_ALL in >= 8/10 repeats, the second sentence is replaced by: 'On overall log R2 no model on the shelf scores above exp046 ({exp046 LOG_ALL}) in at least 8 of 10 repeats.' Nothing else in the template changes.
reporting_rules.allowed_interpretation: The sentence 'log-target training separates materials better than the seconds-scale Poisson GLM on these report-only metrics; the seconds-scale record is unchanged.' may be added after the headline if and only if BOTH PHYS-feature log1p-target models (et_alone and c5_ridge, which differ from exp046 only in target scale and estimator) are above exp046 on LOG_ALL in >= 8/10 repeats. Otherwise it is not written, and no substitute interpretation is offered.
forbidden: setting any number from this run (including ET alone or b2 pooled 50+75) against 0.58, Pomazi or any SOTA figure
the words 'beats', 'win', 'best TTI model' or 'record' attached to a secondary metric

'other fluxes' or 'at 50/75 kW/m2' for the NOT25 legacy mask (say 'non-25 rows pooled (15/35/50/75/100)')
computing any extra mask, metric or exclusion under this config

exit_triggers: None. No number here is compared with any bar, so nothing in this run can trigger EXIT. STOP conditions are step1 / step2 mismatches only (BLOCKED, blocker file, nothing published).
budget: One run of the script. A rerun is allowed only to fix a crash or a code bug that caused a step-1/2 mismatch; each rerun is listed in the critic file with its cause. Never rerun to change a definition.
